parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of model options not being cleared when squashing migrations, but it may introduce unexpected behavior if other options are not intended to be removed.

issues.description: The patch removes options not found in the new operation, which may break existing behavior if those options were intentionally set and not meant to be cleared.
There are no tests provided to verify the behavior of the patch in different scenarios, which increases the risk of regressions.
